positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: DAY TWENTY. ROTATE BTC -> ETH. Quiet, broad-green Sunday tape: eight of nine names are up 0.4-0.8% since Chicago midnight, so there is no standout alt edge and the rule keeps the book in the majors. ETH has the only dated catalyst on the board: Glamsterdam's first public testnet is Tuesday Oct 6, and the 24-48h run-up to a named upgrade milestone is the asymmetric window. ETH reclaimed 2,700 overnight and closed September with about +7%, its best September since 2016. It lagged today's bounce (+0.40%), so this is a pre-position, not a chase. Board (Robinhood mark vs CT-midnight open): LINK +0.77%, DOGE +0.74%, ADA +0.70%, SOL +0.67%, XRP +0.66%, BTC +0.63%, LTC +0.59%, ETH +0.40%, AVAX -0.47%.

ETH has lagged on weak relative strength (#8 of 9 today), and the last ETH hold lost 2.24%. The testnet is sell-the-news-prone, and a delay or bug would hit sentiment. The Fed-hike debate for Oct 28 and Monday's cash-open risk-off could hit beta. Weekend liquidity is thin.
